limitations: Not a production release or engineering approval. Structural strength, sealing, manufacturing tolerances and physical prototypes remain unvalidated.
Movement animation is a deterministic visual kinematic study, not a torque, force or wear simulation.
Native static gear poses and browser corrected animated phases are distinct presentations.
Saved validation checks identity, sampled seats, topology and shared coordinates; it does not certify complete mechanical clearances.

Capture source identity covers first-party viewer source only; native/model/vendor identities are inventoried separately. Refresh captures whose source digest differs from the current viewer revision. Source identity does not imply visual acceptance.
Performance evidence is device- and profile-specific. Physical-phone and controlled-network acceptance must be assessed separately.
